articles.title: Strategy books $8.2 billion Q2 loss on bitcoin price decline
articles.snippet: The world's largest corporate bitcoin holder says it has built a cash reserve covering more than two years of dividend payments after investors questioned its growing stack of preferred securities.

articles.title: $38M in Bitcoin Drained by Coldcard Key Flaw Its Maker Thinks AI Found
articles.snippet: Coinkite said it’s likely that an attacker used AI to review previous versions of its open source firmware to uncover a vulnerability.

articles.title: Australia Sues Telegram for $38M Over ‘Pro-Terror’ Videos
articles.snippet: The eSafety Commissioner accused the social media platform of failing to detect material relating to the Christchurch and Buffalo attacks.

articles.title: There's a New Way to Protect Bitcoin From Future Quantum Attacks, Researchers Say
articles.snippet: New research outlines a cryptographic approach that could allow Bitcoin and other blockchain wallets to remain compatible with existing addresses in a post-quantum future.

articles.title: Russia Charges Telegram's Pavel Durov With Aiding Terrorism
articles.snippet: Durov has previously called Russia’s criminal case against him "a sad spectacle of a state afraid of its own people."
